CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Susan Jakubowski, Mayor  www.cityofsanmarino.org
Steve Talt, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone
Steven W. Huang, DDS, Council Member  (626) 300-0709 Fax
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber
Ken Ude, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Marcella Marlowe, Ph.D., City Manager  San Marino, CA 91108

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 14, 2022 AT 6:00 P.M.
  BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council with
valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically, adjourned
meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires
a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact
the City Clerk via email at cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone at (626) 300-0705 prior
to the meeting for assistance.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the City Council may teleconference into the meeting without noticing each
teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID-19) ADVISORY
To protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, it is recommended that members of
the public wear a mask indoors, per the State and County Health Department’s current Health
Officer Orders. Given the seriousness of COVID-19, you are encouraged to provide input
electronically if you do not feel comfortable attending in person.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  1) Via Computer for Video Streaming:
  Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83316497270
  2) Via Phone for Audio Only:
  Phone Number: (669) 900-9128
  Meeting ID: 833 1649 7270
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 14, 2022  PAGE 2 OF 5

How to offer public comment from home:

  1) Public comment will be accepted by email to cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org until 3:00
  p.m. the day of the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment. Lengthy
  public comment may be summarized in the interest of time. Any comments received after
  3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be read at the
  meeting.
  2) Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Council Member Huang, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Council
  Member Ude, Vice Mayor Talt, and Mayor Jakubowski

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall, 2200
Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman Building,
1560 Pasqualito Drive.  The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.CityofSanMarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At this
time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to
state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda
(Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place limits on duration
of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

1. RECEIVE AND FILE THE MONTHLY DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR JULY
  2022

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of July 2022.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 14, 2022  PAGE 3 OF 5

2. RECEIVE AND FILE THE MONTHLY DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR
  AUGUST 2022

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of August 2022.

3. RECEIVE AND FILE CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR JUNE 2022

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Cash and
  Investment Report for the month of June 2022.

4. RECEIVE AND FILE CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR JULY 2022

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Cash and
  Investment Report for the month of July 2022.

5. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the special meeting of
  July 8, 2022, the regular meeting of July 13, 2022, and the adjourned regular meeting of July
  29, 2022.

6. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R-22-35 TO CONTINUE HYBRID PUBLIC
  MEETINGS PURSUANT TO AB 361

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-22-35 re-
  authorizing the City Council and the City’s Boards and Commissions to continue
  teleconference accessibility for conducting public meetings pursuant to AB 361.

7. UPDATE ON CITY RESPONSE TO THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the September 14,
  2022 report on the City’s response to the COVID-19 Pandemic.

8. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO R-22-33, UPDATING THE CONFLICT OF
  INTEREST CODE OF THE CITY OF SAN MARINO

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-22-33,
  updating the Conflict of Interest Code of the City of San Marino.

9. APPOINTMENT OF MEMBERS TO THE DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council appoint Rick Chou as a regular
  member to the Design Review Committee to serve the term ending on June 30, 2023, and
  Suzanne Torgeson as an alternate member to the Design Review Committee to serve the
  term ending on June 30, 2023.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 14, 2022  PAGE 4 OF 5

10. APPROVAL OF 2020 STATE HOMELAND SECURITY PROGRAM GRANT FOR
  PURCHASE OF MOBILE COMMAND POST

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council authorize the City Manager to
  enter into a subrecipient agreement with the County of Los Angeles for the 2020 State
  Homeland Security Program and add $67,518 of estimated revenues to account 240-00-3202-
  0000 (Homeland Security Grant) and appropriate $67,518 to account 240-30-4613-0000
  (Capitalized Equipment) from the Homeland Security Grant Fund.

11. AWARD OF COMMUNITY SERVICES GUIDE PRODUCTION AGREEMENT
  TO THE SAUCE CREATIVE SERVICES CORP WITH A YEAR 1 CONTRACT
  AMOUNT OF $47,400

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council award a Professional Services
  Agreement in the amount of $47,400 to The Sauce Creative Services Corp for the production
  of four (4) Community Services Guides for Year 1, with the City Manager being authorized
  to execute the agreement on behalf of the City, as well as two one-year contract extensions
  subject to satisfactory performance.

12. APPROVAL TO PURCHASE MOTOROLA HANDHELD RADIOS AS PART OF
  THE APPROVED FY 2022-23 OPERATING AND CAPITAL BUDGET

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council waive competitive bidding and
  approve the purchase of Motorola handheld radios in an amount not to exceed $309,266 and
  approve a budget amendment and appropriation of $7,338 from the Capital Improvement
  Plan Reserves to account 591-34-4613-0561.

13. APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT NO. 1 OF PROFESSIONAL SERVICES
  AGREEMENT WITH MCNULTY CONSULTING FOR THE SAN MARINO 2021-
  2029 HOUSING ELEMENT UPDATE

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve Amendment No. 1 with
  McNulty Consulting for completion of the additional revisions to the City’s 2021-2029 (6th
  Cycle) Housing Element and submittal and coordination of review of the document with the
  State HCD for final adoption, and authorize the City Manager to execute said amendment.

14. APPROVAL OF AGREEMENT AMENDMENT NO. 1 WITH RINCON
  CONSULTANTS TO PROVIDE CONTRACT PLANNING SERVICES
  THROUGH SEPTEMBER 14, 2025

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve Amendment No. 1 with
  Rincon Consultants, which will extend the agreement for a term to expire on September 14,
  2025 for their continued contract planning services, and authorize the City Manager to
  execute the amendment on behalf of the City.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 14, 2022  PAGE 5 OF 5

15. APPROVAL TO PROCURE AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR FOR
  CHILLER AT CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO
  EXCEED $70,000

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the procurement of an
  air conditioning compressor for the chiller at the Crowell Public Library from Control Air in
  an amount not to exceed $70,000.

  NEW BUSINESS

16. RECEIVE AND FILE RECOMMENDATIONS FROM THE DEI TASK FORCE
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council discuss potential DEI projects,
  provide staff direction on projects to begin research on, and receive and file the DEI Task
  Force Recommendations.

  PRESENTATION

17. PRESENTATION OF CITY COUNCIL RECOGNITIONS

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City received
by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San Marino to at
least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available at
the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108,
and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will available for review at the City
Council meeting.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

ADJOURNMENT

Dated: September 9, 2022  CHRISTINA BAKER
Posted: September 9, 2022  CITY CLERK
